adjudication.rationale: The diff makes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` an array and, for COLLECTIVE team events, `handleNewBooking` explicitly pushes additional team members' `destinationCalendar` entries onto `evt.destinationCalendar` (`evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`). However, when persisting the booking, the Prisma write only connects the first element: `connect: { id: evt.destinationCalendar[0].id }` (packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts). That means the additional destination calendars carried on `evt` are not persisted to `booking.destinationCalendar` (which remains singular in usage), so any later flows that reconstruct `evt` from `booking.destinationCalendar` (e.g. confirm.handler, Stripe/PayPal webhook handlers shown in the diff wrapping `booking.destinationCalendar` into a single-element array) will lose the extra calendars and thus won't create calendar events for the other hosts in deferred-creation scenarios.
